categories.name: The Hearth & Culinary
categories.description: Cooking, comfort dishes, and managing The Hearth Eatery & Tavern.

categories.name: Mine-Dungeon & Combat
categories.description: 150-floor mine exploration and defeating Warden Bosses.

categories.name: Tactical Trials (Moderate Hard)
categories.description: Reflex deflections, frugal survival, and Action RPG tactical feats.

categories.name: Four-Season Harvest
categories.description: Four-season agriculture, livestock husbandry, and valley angling.

categories.name: Heart Bonds & Healing
categories.description: Resolving psychological scars, community bonds, and heartfelt ties.

categories.name: Restoration & Remembrance
categories.description: Town board public works and cleansing blighted soils at the Altar.

categories.name: Quirky & Secrets
categories.description: Mischievous valley accidents and delightfully grounded mishaps.

achievements.name: The First Spark
achievements.description: Light the ovens of The Hearth and prepare your first dish (Forest Salted Rice Balls).
achievements.hint: Cook any meal at the tavern kitchen.

achievements.name: Spreading Warmth
achievements.description: Successfully serve 50 evening dinner guests at The Hearth Eatery & Tavern.
achievements.hint: Open the tavern to serve guests each evening.

achievements.name: Midnight at Oakhaven
achievements.description: Serve a midnight dessert and spiced wine order for Valen de Montfort past 22:00.
achievements.hint: A shaded guest on the 2nd floor only dines after midnight...

achievements.name: Moonlit Cook
achievements.description: Successfully cook 25 out of 55 recipes in Grandmother Amalia's Journal.
achievements.hint: Discover and cook 25 different recipes.

achievements.name: Food for the Weary
achievements.description: Serve the exact Comfort Dish to 15 different NPCs during evening dinner service.
achievements.hint: Pay attention to villagers' moods and favorite comfort foods.

achievements.name: Master of the Hearth
achievements.description: Master all 55/55 culinary recipes; reach 250+ Tavern Cozy Rating.
achievements.hint: Cook every single recipe and upgrade tavern amenities.

achievements.name: Grand Feast Night
achievements.description: Earn 5,000 gold in a single evening tavern dinner shift.
achievements.hint: Prepare high-tier meals and warming beverages for packed nights.

achievements.name: Tangled Roots
achievements.description: Defeat the Biome 1 Warden (Root Horror) on Floor 30 of the Mines.
achievements.hint: Delve past the first 30 floors of the Mine-Dungeon.

achievements.name: Frozen Heart
achievements.description: Defeat the Biome 2 Frost Golem on Floor 70 of the Mines.
achievements.hint: Endure the sub-zero chill of the Glacial Caverns.

achievements.name: Molten Depths
achievements.description: Defeat the Biome 3 Magma Wyrm on Floor 110 of the Mines.
achievements.hint: Survive the scorching heat of the Magma Caverns.

achievements.name: Conqueror of the Abyss
achievements.description: Defeat the Campaign Final Boss (Abyssal Warden) on Floor 150 of the Mines.
achievements.hint: Complete all 150 campaign floors of the Mine-Dungeon.

achievements.name: Vein Hunter
achievements.description: Mine 100 iron ores, 50 gold ores, and 10 precious gems.
achievements.hint: Mine deep subterranean veins for metals and crystals.

achievements.name: Blasting Prodigy
achievements.description: Demolish 50 giant blocking boulders using Gomer's craft explosives.
achievements.hint: Use mining bombs to blast obstructive boulders.

achievements.name: Ironclad Deflection
achievements.description: Successfully execute 15 consecutive Master Parries during a Boss encounter without taking damage.
achievements.hint: Time your guards perfectly against boss attack windups.

achievements.name: Minimalist Delver
achievements.description: Descend 30 consecutive mine floors carrying at most 2 bento rations and 1 torch.
achievements.hint: Leave heavy gear behind and descend with sparse provisions.

achievements.name: Into the Void
achievements.description: Reach Floor 180 of the Infinite Abyss (Floors 151+).
achievements.hint: Push past Floor 150 into the endless subterranean depths.

achievements.name: Untouchable Vanguard
achievements.description: Defeat any Warden Boss with Rowan's HP remaining above 90%.
achievements.hint: Master dodging and parrying against boss attack patterns.

achievements.name: Fed to Survive
achievements.description: Traverse the Magma Caverns (Floors 71-110) using zero healing potions, relying entirely on culinary buffs.
achievements.hint: Cook heat-warding and regenerative dishes before entering magma shafts.

achievements.name: Beating the Blight
achievements.description: Strip-mine all ore veins on a blighted floor and escape before the miasma gauge hits 100%.
achievements.hint: Mine expeditiously and find the ladder before miasma overcomes you.

achievements.name: Green Thumb of Oakhaven
achievements.description: Plant and harvest all 32/32 seasonal botanical crops across spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
achievements.hint: Rotate seasonal crops and utilize the four-season greenhouse.

achievements.name: Clockwork Orchard
achievements.description: Install Cogsworth's Automated Sprinkler Network and Kael's Breeding Station.
achievements.hint: Mechanize farmstead irrigation and seed cloning.

achievements.name: The Contented Herd
achievements.description: Raise dairy cows, sheep, and chickens to maximum 5-star affection with Hazel.
achievements.hint: Feed, brush, and care for your livestock daily.

achievements.name: Whisper Lake Angler
achievements.description: Catch all 15 fish species across brooks, marsh creeks, and underground lakes.
achievements.hint: Fish across varying weather conditions, lakes, and cavern grottos.

achievements.name: Monstrous Harvest
achievements.description: Harvest a giant mutant crop (3x3 grid) during the autumn harvest season.
achievements.hint: Plant matching crops in 3x3 plots with daily care.

achievements.name: Stamina Conservationist
achievements.description: Work from 06:00 to 23:00 completing hoeing, watering, chopping, and mining while keeping stamina above 10%.
achievements.hint: Pace daily labor and take midday meal snacks to avoid collapse.

achievements.name: Heart of the Village
achievements.description: Reach 2 Hearts affection with all 51 characters in the game.
achievements.hint: Greet and share hospitality with every resident in the valley.

achievements.name: Blood and Iron
achievements.description: Complete the 8-Heart reconciliation event for brothers Boris & Bram Barnaby.
achievements.hint: Help the estranged smithing brothers reconcile over their mother's goulash.

achievements.name: A Hearth for Kael
achievements.description: Complete the 8-Heart family event between Granny Maeve & Kael.
achievements.hint: Stand by grandmother and orphan boy as they find true family.

achievements.name: Unmasked Loyalty
achievements.description: Complete the 8-Heart forgiveness event between Valerius & Hester.
achievements.hint: Help the hiding knight face her former commander with courage.

achievements.name: The Great Kinship
achievements.description: Reach 8 Hearts affection with 30 or more characters.
achievements.hint: Build lasting bonds across the majority of valley residents.

achievements.name: Full Memory Wall
achievements.description: Complete all 51 Signature Milestone Scenes and fill the Polaroid Memory Wall at The Hearth.
achievements.hint: Reach the peak heart milestone (8/6/4 Hearts by tier) across all valley residents and world entities.

achievements.name: Architect of Oakhaven
achievements.description: Complete all 12 community public restoration works on the Town Board.
achievements.hint: Donate lumber, stone, and funds to restore ruined infrastructure.

achievements.name: Flame of Remembrance
achievements.description: Deliver the Memorial Soul Banquet with Rosemary at the Ancient Altar, banishing miasma.
achievements.hint: Cook 5 ceremonial feast dishes to cleanse wartime spiritual scars.

achievements.name: Crossroads of Five Realms
achievements.description: Unlock all 4 trade routes connecting the Five Great Realms.
achievements.hint: Establish regular trading ties with merchants across all four foreign realms.

achievements.name: Vault of Ages
achievements.description: Appraise and donate 30 mine relics to complete Iris's Oakhaven Museum.
achievements.hint: Bring excavated cavern relics to Iris for appraisal.

achievements.name: Night Market Regular
achievements.description: Purchase wares at Bramble's VIP Saturday Night Market for 4 consecutive weeks.
achievements.hint: Visit Bramble's clandestine bazaar each Saturday evening.

achievements.name: Egg-splosion!
achievements.description: Burn a dish and accidentally blow up a pot of boiling eggs with Colm in the tavern kitchen.
achievements.hint: Even culinary clumsiness has its charms...

achievements.name: Pants on the Paling
achievements.description: Catch young Milo stealing strawberries and rescue his snagged trousers off the fence 3 times.
achievements.hint: Strange rustling noises by the strawberry fence...

achievements.name: Barnaby's Clean Floor
achievements.description: Walk muddy boots across the polished hardwood floors 10 times right before Barnaby's eyes.
achievements.hint: The elderly steward despises mud...

achievements.name: Unstoppable Sloth
achievements.description: Try pushing or leading Silas's stubborn old mule for 3 continuous minutes without it moving an inch.
achievements.hint: The pack mule can be exceptionally stubborn...

achievements.name: So Close, Yet So Far
achievements.description: Faint and lose your expedition haul on Floor 149, right outside the Campaign Boss chamber.
achievements.hint: A bitter tumble on the very last doorstep...

achievements.name: Swamp Stumble
achievements.description: Take a swig of Old Tad's homemade marsh hooch and stumble about tipsy for 30 seconds.
achievements.hint: Never accept bubbling hooch from marsh fishermen...

achievements.name: Unmoved Feline
achievements.description: Pet Mallow 20 consecutive times while he continues sleeping peacefully without batting an eye.
achievements.hint: Mallow values afternoon naps above all...

achievements.name: Ringing in the Ears
achievements.description: Stand too close when Gomer ignites blasting powder, causing screen tremors and muffled audio for 10 seconds.
achievements.hint: Maintain a safe distance from dwarf explosives...

achievements.name: Cave Tripping
achievements.description: Eat a raw luminescent cave mushroom while starving, causing a 15-second purple psychedelic visual tint.
achievements.hint: Deep cavern hunger drives questionable snacking decisions...

achievements.name: Midnight Nibbler
achievements.description: Raid the kitchen stewpot at 01:00 AM under the silent judging gaze of Mallow and Pip.
achievements.hint: Late night kitchens hold irresistible temptations...

achievements.name: Ass on Ice
achievements.description: Sprint across slippery ice sheets by Vael's tarn camp and slip flat on your back 5 times.
achievements.hint: Glacial tarn ice offers zero friction...

achievements.name: Lumberjack Disaster
achievements.description: Fell a tall pine on the homestead boundary and crush Maeve's wooden fence rail.
achievements.hint: Watch where the pine topples before swinging...

achievements.name: Uncollectible Tab
achievements.description: Chase down a diner skipping out on their tab, only to receive 2 rusted coppers and a shriveled turnip.
achievements.hint: Post-war poverty makes debt collecting tricky...

achievements.name: Sheep Traffic Jam
achievements.description: Get trapped in a narrow lane surrounded on all sides by Tilly's plump sheep for 30 seconds.
achievements.hint: Never block narrow alleys when Tilly herds her flock home...
